structured.answer: With the 500 ₪ a month that was already filled in, the calculator shows about 25,725 ₪ after 4 years, but it says it doesn't yet work out the tax for self-employed people taking money out before 6 years, so the real amount would be lower. After 8 years it shows about 68,853 ₪ left in hand, in today's money: 48,000 that I put in plus a tax refund and earnings, with no tax.
